text:
Alex S: Heads-up — Nimbus Supply reporting a cluster of invoice payments failing this morning. ~12 customers, different acquirers. Customers hit "card declined" after completing 3DS. Can we triage?

Rachel F: What decline codes are we seeing? INS_FUNDS vs AUTH_REJECTED vs CHALLENGE_FAILED?

Alex S: quick breakdown from logs: 7x `insufficient_funds`, 5x `challenge_failed` (3DS flow). Sample acquirer response attached below.

Alex S: ```json
{
  "payment_id":"pay_8f3a2b",
  "status":"failed",
  "acquirer_code":"51",
  "acquirer_message":"Insufficient funds",
  "sca_status":"challenge_failed",
  "redirect_url":"https://acs.example/3ds?tx=abc123"
}
```

Jamie (eng): Need repro steps and whether merchant is using redirect or iframe. iFrame tends to cause more origin/cookie issues. Which integration do they use?

Tom (Nimbus): We use the embedded modal (iframe) on checkout, same integration since launch. Some users say the 3DS popup closes immediately after auth.

Maria Payments: Two things to check: (1) issuer ACS timeouts / user abandoning challenge (looks like challenge_failed), (2) our fraud rules — are we auto-declining after failed 3DS or falling back incorrectly?

Alex S: Repro notes I'm collecting: browser + OS, payment SDK version (we asked for v3.2.1), merchant session id, full 3DS receipt (sca_receipt) and network trace. Also saw one frontend error: 

```
POST /payments/3ds/callback 400 invalid_origin
```

Jamie (eng): that invalid_origin on callback with iframe = likely CORS/origin mismatch or missing postMessage handling. If ACS posts back to parent, origin checks can drop the result and we record as failed. Can reproduce locally by forcing iFrame flow + closing popup early.

Ops Bot: Deploy notice: payments-service v2.14 rolled 2025-08-17 04:30 UTC to prod. No immediate rollbacks.

Rachel F: Also check fraud engine logs for these payment_ids — ensure a failed challenge didn't trigger a velocity + autodecline rule. I can search for correlated signals (velocity, BIN risk, shipping mismatch).

Maria Payments: Playbook suggestion (quick):
1) Ask merchant for 2-3 failing payment_ids + browser trace + sca_receipt.
2) Confirm integration type (iframe vs redirect) and SDK version.
3) Pull acquirer/ACS responses and 3DS challenge timestamps.
4) Check payments-service logs for origin/callback errors and fraud-rule hits.
5) If iframe + invalid_origin, advise merchant to switch to redirect or update origin whitelist.
6) If auth_insufficient_funds, confirm we passed correct amount/currency and no double-auth happened.
7) If fraud-rule involved, disable aggressive rule for the merchant and manually approve the affected payments.

Jamie (eng): I'll add a short repro harness: curl to our /simulate/3ds with test-card emulators to reproduce challenge closure. If we see `invalid_origin` in the service logs, that's our top suspect.

Alex S: I'll open a ticket with Nimbus and ask for the items above. Tom, can you capture one network HAR and the failing payment_id?

Tom (Nimbus): Yep — sending HAR + payment ids now in the ticket.

Rachel F: If we confirm fraud-rule false positives, I'll patch the rule and handle refunds/credits. If it's ACS timeout/iframe, we'll provide mitigation guidance and an ops note.

Alex S: Summary action items: collect traces + sca receipts (Alex/Tom), dev repro (Jamie), fraud audit (Rachel), advise merchant (Maria). Escalating to payments-sre if rate > 5% in next hour. :white_check_mark:

Alex S: Thanks all — will update thread when we have receipts.
